text:
The text establishes a clear cause-and-effect relationship regarding the implementation of a strict recycling program. The cause is the introduction of this program, which directly led to a remarkable decrease in landfill waste. This reduction in waste then caused two further effects: a significant reduction in environmental pollution and savings in waste management costs, as reported by the local government.

Regarding the specific question asked at the end of the text, the country famous for the Great Barrier Reef is Australia.
